stratagem.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagem.lore: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s attacks have: ▪ +1 S. ▪ [Lethal Hits].

stratagem.name: MORTIS SNARES
stratagem.lore: These stealth operatives lace the battlefield with explosive devices that trigger by mico-auspex and las- wire when foes blunder into them.
stratagem.target: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.
stratagem.effect: If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6: ▪ On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. ▪ That objective is no longer snared.

stratagem.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagem.lore: At an opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
stratagem.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagem.target: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.
stratagem.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
